cloudOff.name: update
cloudOff.description: Merges the latest commits of the base from the remote into the branch the thread's folder is on, with a merge commit, so a branch already pushed is never rewritten; other threads working in the same folder get them too, and the answer names them in sharedWith. A folder with changes no commit holds is refused first with the files named. A merge that conflicts is taken back at once and answered with the files that conflict, the folder left exactly as it was; fix sends those to the agent. Nothing is pushed.

thread.description: the thread, by its id or a prefix of it that names one, as threads lists them

sharedWith.description: the other threads working in the same folder, by id, whose changes the act took in too; absent where none do
